subject: Next steps: hosting path & compliance evidence for MediAssist
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@mediassist.com>, David Liu <d.liu@mediassist.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed evidence path (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Hi Sarah, David —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of ask:
- You confirmed PHI flow from your intake forms into an LLM-driven triage service (priority: auditability and data segregation).
- Primary constraints: BAA required, SOC2 Type II evidence requested for infrastructure controls, and an audit window in Q1 2027.

Redwood hosting options we discussed (short pros/cons for your team):
- Hosted API: fastest to launch, needs strict routing + DLP for PHI. BAA available; SOC2 evidence we can provide but multi-tenant model may be a blocker for your auditors.
- Dedicated capacity: dedicated GPU pool, stronger isolation, predictable throughput; good trade-off if auditors accept Hosted with dedicated tenancy at infra layer.
- Private VPC / On-prem: highest isolation and preferred for strict audit/regulatory requirements (you indicated this was your default preference if auditors push back).

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you share the full SOC2 scope your auditors expect (infrastructure only vs application controls)? Attach any questionnaire if available.
2) We’ll send a short compliance matrix mapping evidence we can provide (SOC2 artifacts, BAA language, data residency controls) — draft attached.
3) If you want Private VPC, please confirm which cloud provider / VPC CIDR constraints we should plan for.

Timeline proposal:
- This week (by Oct 21): you share questionnaire; we’ll return completed matrix and a recommended hosting route.
- Week of Oct 25: alignment call with your security reviewer (we’ll include our security engineer).

Attachments: MediAssist-MA-Compliance-Matrix.xlsx (draft)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the matrix populated based on today’s notes.

Best,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
M: +1 415-555-0172
https://redwood.ai
From: Sarah Park <sarah.park@mediassist.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Liu <d.liu@mediassist.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T20:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed evidence path (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Thanks, Rafael — appreciate the concise recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Our auditors will require SOC2 Type II reports covering infrastructure and platform change management for any vendor that processes PHI. Application-level controls are in scope but lower priority for this decision.
- BAA is a prerequisite. We have a standard vendor security questionnaire; attaching the latest version (MediAssist-Security-Questionnaire.pdf).
- Preferred deployment: Private VPC (we control routing and peering), but we’re open to Dedicated if you can provide the SOC2 artifact and a clear diagram showing network separation.

Questions: 
1) For Private VPC, do you support AWS and GCP? Any limitations on region (we need US-east and US-west availability).
2) If we start with Dedicated to accelerate launch, what is the expected window to migrate from Dedicated -> Private VPC (if auditors push for that after engagement)?

I’ll aim to have the completed questionnaire back by Friday EOD.

—Sarah
Sarah Park
Head of Security & Compliance | MediAssist Health
sarah.park@mediassist.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@mediassist.com>, David Liu <d.liu@mediassist.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed evidence path (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Sarah — thanks for the quick note and the questionnaire. 

Answers inline and next steps: 

1) Provider & regions: we support AWS and GCP for Private VPC. We can provision in us-east-1 and us-west-2; cross-region failover is supported but will require an onboarding window (see migration timeline below).

2) Dedicated -> Private migration: typical path is 4–8 weeks depending on network approvals and IAM provisioning. If you choose Dedicated now, we can reserve capacity and run canary traffic while we provision the VPC. Migration checklist: VPC peering, route table approvals, customer KMS integration (if required), and signed network ACLs.

SOC2 artifacts: we will provide our latest SOC2 Type II report and a controls matrix linking each questionnaire item to evidence. We can also provide an Azure AD / Okta integration guide and key rotation policy excerpts. We’ll attach the SOC2 link in the shared Drive and a redacted copy suitable for auditors.

Proposed immediate plan:
- Oct 19–21: Rafael / Marissa to populate the questionnaire and return to you (we’ll mark redactions for sensitive items).
- Oct 25: Security sync — Redwood security engineer (Marissa) + your security reviewer.
- Nov 1: If you sign the BAA and choose Dedicated, we can begin provisioning reserved capacity the following week.

I’m attaching the filled draft matrix (updated) and a one-pager on migration steps.

Attachments: MediAssist-MA-Compliance-Matrix.xlsx (updated)

Best,
Rafael

- Dedicated reserved capacity (GPU types + monthly commit)
- Private VPC onboarding lead time (IAM, peering, KMS integration)
